headline: Sherro Build
title: Sherro Best Build | Flowing Water Slash and Torrent Slam | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Sherro is a Water attacker, and its skills love puddles. Run Flowing Water Slash, three quick slashes that turn into water blades near water, with Torrent Slam, a thrown shell that deals extra damage in puddles. Pair it with a Panpanta or Erlath to make puddles. Hold a Ferocious Fang. Beware Lightning, Grass and Ice. Do you run Sherro? Comment below!
